tasks.title: Announcement #73
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university club meeting.
tasks.transcript: Welcome, everyone. Today, we'll be discussing our plans for Earth Day. We'll be organizing a campus cleanup event and planting trees next Friday. Please sign up if you're interested in participating.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：Today, we'll be discussing our plans for Earth Day. We'll be organizing a campus cleanup event and planting trees next Friday. 选项分析： A. A tree-planting workshop 一个植树工作坊。公告中提到植树，但这是地球日活动的一部分，不是主要内容，所以A选项错误。 B. A club meeting schedule 俱乐部会议安排。公告中未提及会议时间安排，所以B选项错误。 C. A decision about club membership 关于俱乐部成员资格的决定。公告中未提及成员资格，所以C选项错误。 D. An Earth Day initiative 一项地球日活动倡议。公告明确讨论地球日的计划（campus cleanup event 和 planting trees），所以D选项正确。

questions.stem: What are students encouraged to do?

options.A: Donate to the tree planting fund
options.C: Sign up for the cleanup event

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：鼓励学生们做什么？ 定位原文：Please sign up if you're interested in participating. （结合上文提到的“campus cleanup event and planting trees”） 选项分析： A. Donate to the tree planting fund 向植树基金捐款。公告中未提及捐款，所以A选项错误。 B. Attend a workshop 参加工作坊。公告中未提及工作坊，所以B选项错误。 C. Sign up for the cleanup event 报名参加清洁活动。公告明确说“请报名”（sign up），活动内容包括校园清洁和植树，所以C选项正确。 D. Join the Environmental Club 加入环保俱乐部。公告中未提及加入俱乐部，这是俱乐部会议，但鼓励的是参与活动而非加入组织，所以D选项错误。
